text: He learned to play on the accordion. The folks all thought it might be queer. No matter what that gal would hear, he'd sit right down and play by ear. My Irene is a village dream. She's the queen of a village dream. And when she plays on the accordion, a clicker gal will you never see. Don't you sell on the thinking scale. They never could touch Irene. Everybody owns her.
